title: Three Years and One Short Plan
subtitle: 国家公民 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 国家公民（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·国家与公民）
meta: 主题语境：国家公民（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·国家与公民）　|　核心词汇：billion　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 billion 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1985 the planner ① counted the billion that no citizen in the district would have recorded, and he said the counting was the whole of the year. The ② billion, meaning the figure itself and not the plan, ran three years and stayed unrecorded in the book; a billion, he said, is the only thing in a district that is judged by how long it is left unrecorded.

Every ③ billion in that district had the same short plan beside it, and the ④ billion at the far square, meaning the plot they kept for the children to measure and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A billion, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to record; the planner said the recording is the part that fills three years.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the billion was the whole of the matter, meaning the fortune and not the figure. The ⑥ billion, meaning the fortune and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody records; billion, he said, is either something you count or the only word that means both a figure and a fortune. He said the fortune is the part they remember.

By 1990 the ⑦ billion had become a line in a report, and the report had become an argument about the short plan. The ⑧ billion of the whole thing, the planner wrote in March, was one district and three years of recording; billion, he said, is either the plot at the far square or the reason you learned to record. He said the recording was never mentioned.

The ⑨ billion I remember is the figure recorded in the report, which closed in 1992 and is still recorded as the quietest in the district. A ⑩ billion, my mother said in 1994, is the only figure that improves by being recorded; every billion, she said, is a fortune that has agreed to look like a figure. She said the fortune was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 十亿；巨额（指街区里每一笔旁边的那一笔）
B. n. 十亿；巨额（指那笔十亿本身，与薄薄的图纸相对）
C. 固定搭配：count the billion 清点这一笔十亿
D. n. 十亿；巨额（指留给孩子们丈量的那一块）
E. n. 十亿之事（抽象总称，指一处街区的十亿之事）
F. n. 十亿；巨额（指规划报告里写到、被记载的那一笔）
G. n. 十亿、一笔财富（指一件事里人人都用却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 一笔财富（抽象总称，指人人都用却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: counted the billion that no citizen in the district would have recorded
The billion, meaning the figure itself and not the plan
the billion at the far square
the billion was the whole of the matter
the billion had become a line in a report
The billion of the whole thing
A billion, my mother said in 1994

answers.why: count the billion 意为“清点这一笔十亿”，1985 年那位规划员把街区里没有一位市民肯记载的一笔十亿做了一遍。
billion 意为“十亿；巨额”，指那笔十亿本身而不是薄薄的图纸，它经过了三个年份而在簿子上没有被记载。
billion 意为“十亿；巨额”，指街区里每一笔旁边的那一笔，每一笔旁边都有同一张薄薄的图纸。
billion 意为“十亿；巨额”，指最远那处广场的留给孩子们丈量的那一块，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
billion 意为“十亿、一笔财富”，指一件事里人人都用却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这笔一笔财富就是那件事的全部。
billion 意为“一笔财富”，指人人都用却无人提起的那样东西而不是那笔十亿，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
billion 意为“十亿；巨额”，指规划报告里写到、被记载的那一笔，到 1990 年这一笔成了规划报告里的一行。
billion 意为“十亿之事”，规划员三月写道，整件事的十亿之事是一处街区和三个年份的记载。
billion 意为“十亿；巨额”，我记得的是规划报告里记载过的那一笔，1992 年落成了，至今仍被说成街区里最安静的一笔。
billion 为抽象总称，母亲 1994 年说，十亿是唯一会因为被好好记载而变得更好的十亿。
